title: A Benchmark for Controllable Speaking-Style Captioning in Audio-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.33036v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Speaking-style captioning (SSC) aims to generate natural language descriptions of how speech is delivered, capturing paralinguistic attributes such as vocal timbre, prosody, and expressivity. Many downstream applications, including conversational AI agents, controllable speech generation, and large-scale audio annotation, require dimension-specific style captions that describe targeted aspects of speech (e.g., speaker traits, emotion, or delivery style), rather than a single undifferentiated description. However, existing work lacks a unified formulation for controllable speaking-style captioning. We address this gap by formulating SSC as an instruction-following audio-language task, where explicit instructions specify the speaking-style dimensions to be described. translated_title: 音频-语言模型中可控说话风格描述的基准测试
translated_abstract: 说话风格描述（SSC）旨在生成关于语音如何被表达的自然语言描述，捕捉诸如音色、韵律和表现力等副语言属性。许多下游应用，包括对话式AI智能体、可控语音生成和大规模音频标注，都需要针对特定维度的风格描述来刻画语音的特定方面（例如说话人特质、情感或表达风格），而不是单一的、不加区分的描述。然而，现有工作缺乏对可控说话风格描述的统一形式化定义。我们通过将SSC形式化为一个遵循指令的音频-语言任务来填补这一空白，其中明确的指令指定了需要描述的说话风格维度。我们推出了StyleInstructCaps，这是首个面向音频-语言模型中可控说话风格描述的标准化基准。StyleInstructCaps提供了一个数据集……
tldr: 提出StyleInstructCaps——首个可控说话风格描述的标准化基准，将说话风格描述形式化为指令跟随的音频-语言任务，通过明确指令指定需描述的风格维度（如说话人特质、情感、表达风格）。
en_tdlr: Introduces StyleInstructCaps, the first standardized benchmark for controllable speaking-style captioning, which formulates SSC as an instruction-following audio-language task where explicit instructions specify which speaking-style dimensions (e.g., speaker traits, emotion, or delivery style) to describe.
